{
  "name": "whats-next",
  "displayName": "What's Next",
  "version": "1.1.6",
  "description": "What's next, issues and milestones from Forgejo, GitLab or GitHub, in docked panes",
  "author": {
    "name": "Erwin Gribnau"
  },
  "license": "AGPL-3.0-only",
  "homepage": "https://github.com/egribnau/whats-next",
  "repository": "https://github.com/egribnau/whats-next",
  "keywords": [
    "issues",
    "milestones",
    "forgejo",
    "gitlab",
    "github",
    "issue-tracker"
  ],
  "privacyPolicyUrl": "https://github.com/egribnau/whats-next#what-it-sends-where",
  "userConfig": {
    "token": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Forgejo tokens",
      "description": "Forgejo or Gitea access tokens, kept in secure storage. A bare token is for every host; more hosts take host=token pairs separated by spaces. A pair wins over a bare token. Needs write:issue, read:repository and read:user to assign, close and change labels and milestones; read:issue instead of write:issue is read only.",
      "default": "",
      "sensitive": true
    },
    "gitlabComToken": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "GitLab.com token",
      "description": "A gitlab.com access token, kept in secure storage. api lets What's Next assign, close and change labels and milestones; read_api is read only.",
      "default": "",
      "sensitive": true
    },
    "gitlabTokens": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Private GitLab token",
      "description": "An access token for your own GitLab, any host but gitlab.com, kept in secure storage. api lets What's Next assign, close and change labels and milestones; read_api is read only. host=token pairs separated by spaces still work for more than one host.",
      "default": "",
      "sensitive": true
    },
    "githubTokens": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "GitHub token",
      "description": "A GitHub access token, for github.com and GitHub Enterprise, kept in secure storage. Fine-grained: Issues read and write to assign, close and change labels and milestones, read for read only; classic: repo. host=token pairs separated by spaces for more than one host; a pair wins over a bare token.",
      "default": "",
      "sensitive": true
    },
    "label": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Epic label",
      "description": "The label that makes an issue an epic. Its children are the issues it depends on; on GitLab, the issues it links as related; on GitHub, its sub-issues.",
      "default": "epic"
    },
    "debug": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Debug",
      "description": "Count What's Next's requests to the forge, on a line under the bottom line: the last action's and the session's.",
      "default": false
    },
    "compact": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Compact",
      "description": "Lists without an empty line between rows. ask: What's Next asks once, after setup.",
      "default": "ask",
      "options": [
        "ask",
        "on",
        "off"
      ]
    },
    "icons": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Icons",
      "description": "Buttons as Nerd Font icons, which needs a Nerd Font in the terminal, or as words. ask: What's Next asks once, after setup.",
      "default": "ask",
      "options": [
        "ask",
        "icons",
        "text"
      ]
    }
  }
}
